instruction: Candid medium shot photograph of two women playing a hand-clapping game in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall. On the left, the woman with short brown hair in a striped shirt (R2) sits facing right, smiling warmly. On the right, the woman with curly afro hair in a purple shirt (R1) sits facing left, smiling back. They are positioned opposite each other, with one pair of hands meeting in the center, palms touching in a high-five, while their other hands are raised mid-air. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused natural light, creating a warm, joyful atmosphere with a neutral color palette.
